Arm manifest shas are null until `node evals/skill-onoff/stamp-g67-amendment.js` runs after the post-merge freeze (see fixture_scripts_freeze.post_merge_steps); a live run refuses to start while they are null.
design: human-readable twin: prereg/stage-graph-g67.md; changes under test: G6 (l4/l5/l6 entry records --size) and G7 (finish-flow close-out runs close-session) of the guidance-v7 branch (194e2ecc)

on.packs: *-sg-change-v8 (freeze-guidance-arm.js change --suffix v8, after the merge of guidance-v8 + close-session) + fixture-scripts-sg + fixture-scripts-g67-v2

allowed_arm_difference.note: v7 change set is FIVE files (four SKILL.md + l5/references/hetero-impl-loop.md, which adds the size to the l5 entry and degrade commands); off and on must differ ONLY in these, enforced file-by-file by run-g67-campaign.js --check-arms on the frozen packs

fixture_scripts_freeze.supersedes: fixture-scripts-g67 (v1; stays in packs/ and manifest.json as history, no arm references it)
fixture_scripts_freeze.command: node evals/skill-onoff/freeze-pack.js --id fixture-scripts-g67-v2 --scripts scripts/session-mode.js,scripts/repo-residue-sweep.js,scripts/pin-evidence-anchors.js,scripts/reap-dispatch-branches.sh,scripts/lib/json-emit.sh,scripts/lib/worktree-reap.sh --ref <merged develop sha containing close-session AND the batch/r2-mech close-session behaviour>
fixture_scripts_freeze.why_explicit_list: freeze-pack follows only literal relative JS requires. session-mode.js is now listed so the plugin root carries it (v1 omitted it: the skill text says <plugin>/scripts/session-mode.js and the eval plugin had only the 13 close-session files). Its literal require graph (campaign-verification, mission-routing-admission, project-key, live-pointer, jsonl-store, and the lazy runs-watch) is followed automatically: checked 2026-10-10 against a7533ce4, 62 files, `node <pack>/scripts/session-mode.js set --level l4 --size XS` exits 0 from the pack alone. repo-residue-sweep.js spawns pin-evidence-anchors.js through path.join(__dirname, ...) and finish-flow runs reap-dispatch-branches.sh (+ the two shell libs), so those stay explicit.
fixture_scripts_freeze.installed_twice: both arm manifests list the pack in fixture_scripts (fixture repo root) AND in files (synthetic PLUGIN root); the second is what puts scripts/session-mode.js and scripts/repo-residue-sweep.js where the skill text looks for them
fixture_scripts_freeze.same_in_both_arms: identical in off.json and on.json; the only variable is the guidance text
post_merge_steps: git -C <merged tree> rev-parse HEAD   # the merged develop sha, call it $SHA; it must contain close-session (batch/r2-mech) and the guidance v8 text

node evals/skill-onoff/freeze-guidance-arm.js change --suffix v8 --arms-dir "$(mktemp -d)"   # from the merged working tree; freezes the 16 *-sg-change-v8 + guidance-files-sg-change-v8; --arms-dir keeps arms/stage-graph untouched. Skip when those packs already exist (the stage-graph v8 row freezes the same ids).
node evals/skill-onoff/run-g67-campaign.js --check-arms   # off(v6) vs on(v8) differ only in the five registered files
node evals/skill-onoff/stamp-g67-amendment.js   # writes the two arm sha256 into this file and the amendment digests into prereg/FROZEN.json
bash hooks/tests/skill-onoff-g67.test.sh && git add -A evals/skill-onoff && git commit   # commit packs + stamp together

ship_rule: SHIP iff EVERY task has ON passing >= on_min_reps of 3 reps AND OFF passing <= off_max_reps of 3 reps
stop_rule: any (task,arm,rep) cell with no clean row (infra_fail or missing) => STOP; rerun that cell (run-g67-campaign.js resumes, max 3 attempts per cell), never score around it
invalid_rule: mixed models, mixed runner versions, a runner version other than runner_version_pin, more than one arm manifest per arm, identical off/on manifests, a registered manifest sha not matched, or the manipulation check (task skill invoked in < 90% of an arm's cells) => INSTRUMENT-INVALID
timeout_semantics: per-cell timeout is the registered stop, not a failure: ONOFF_TIMEOUT_IS_COMPLETE=1 makes exit 124/137 with a non-empty transcript a complete cell (row carries stopped_by_timeout:true). A cell that has not issued the registered call by the timeout scores false for its arm.
scope_lock: authorises ONLY: sonnet depth-0, headless -p, runner 2.1.292, these four briefs, the frozen off/on arm manifests. Says nothing about foreman/hands behaviour after entry, opus/fable, or interactive sessions.

markers.g6_size: the FIRST `session-mode.js set` Bash invocation carrying the task's level (--level lN, or --entry-level lN) also carries --size <XS|S|M|L|XL> (literal)
markers.g7_close: ANY Bash invocation of `repo-residue-sweep.js close-session` carrying --session <non-empty: literal sid or $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID> and --yes

results_files.v1: results/stage-graph-g67.v1.jsonl (arms v7; INSTRUMENT-DEFECTIVE for G6, superseded for G7; kept as recorded, never re-scored)
results_files.v2: results/stage-graph-g67.v2.jsonl (arms v8, the only file a verdict under amendment 1 may come from)

plugin_required_scripts_note: run-g67-campaign.js exports these as ONOFF_REQUIRE_PLUGIN_SCRIPTS; run-skill-onoff-eval.sh require()s each from the assembled scratch plugin before the agent starts. A script that does not load (absent, or a missing module in its require graph) makes the cell infra_fail/plugin_script_unresolvable and the agent is never started (STOP, not a score).
